purpose: Check every named booklet case/example for omitted useful evidence and correct scope/date errors while preserving readable grouped explanations.

Somerset Levels.decision: Retain dated 65 km² early snapshot and previously sourced 100m m³ estimate; do not confuse cubic volume with flooded area. Wider-event extent differs by source/date.

Somerset Levels.booklet_claims: Drainage history, storms and jet stream; 12 storms
Somerset Levels.decision: Added powerful jet stream and at least 12 major UK storms with mid-Dec 2013 to mid-Feb 2014 scope.

Somerset Levels.booklet_claims: Parrett undredged 20 years; £4m each five years; development
Somerset Levels.decision: Explain reduced capacity and exposed development; avoid unsupported one-cause or total-blockage claim.

Add council 600 homes affected (not internally flooded), 81 roads closed, 7,000 businesses indirectly affected and up to £147m economic estimate. Retain agricultural and environmental mechanisms. Hectare/area snapshots not added together.
Add Netherlands pumps/military/police. Pump rates changed during event and booklet lacks time unit for volume; no fixed rate implied.

Somerset Levels.booklet_claims: 20-year plan; dredging; raised road; pumps; water storage; tidal barrier
Somerset Levels.decision: Preserve comparison table; integrate dredging dates/270,500m³, 21 stations, Beer Wall, raised road and catchment storage. Do not say proposed barrier was delivered in 2014.

Dryholme Farm.decision: Added £4m installation cost from Jersey 2015 report; retain 2011 and mechanism. Keep planning 1MW/about1,200 homes with planning scope rather than unsupported 4,000. Later reports use different installed-output estimates, not averaged together. Funding mix not independently established.

Hinkley Point C.booklet_claims: EDF; Chinese finance; £18bn; 25,000 jobs; five million homes
Hinkley Point C.decision: Retain planned 25,000 opportunities and six million homes; add EDF/CGN and £18bn as 2016 historical estimate. Do not present old cost or B closure forecast as current.
Retain high cost/long construction/waste evaluation. Consumer support and investor construction costs are distinct; avoid claiming construction expenditure directly becomes immediate bills.

Hacheston solar example.decision: Add verified May 2014 dismissed appeal, 25MW and about50ha with landscape/heritage/agricultural trade-off. Do not equate 25MW with25,000 homes.

Kirkby Moor wind example.booklet_claims: 2015; twelve42m turbines replaced by six115m turbines
Kirkby Moor wind example.decision: Add 2015 proposal/objection,12 turbines,6 up to115m and landscape/SSSI context. Describe historical planning proposal, not current status.

source_links: Primary and supporting verification links are listed in the canonical notes; school-booklet climate approximations retain their approximate status.
presentation: Short explanatory paragraphs with bold lead-ins; no duplicated summary bullets before expanded prose. Preserve comparison tables, useful diagrams and genuine method/process lists.
